summary.text: William Kendall is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Ron Bryce.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Coffeyville and has spent his adult life in the Coffeyville and Independence area, working in the factory sector and later in retail.

sources.title: William Kendall - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey
